manuscript_hep_reference_checks.sub_002_source_version_note: The archived sub-002 cleaned EEG was saved on 2026-09-01 (EEGLAB 2026.0.0) during pipeline development, before the 2026-09-06 batch that produced the other cleaned EEG files (EEGLAB 2024.0; 2026-09-07 reruns for three IDs). The original batch skipped IDs whose cleaned EEG already existed. Rebuilt minus reference differences are a low-rank, frontal spatial pattern present in the baseline, consistent with a different ICA cleaning of the EEG rather than with regression or epoching settings. The cleaned EEG version used for the published sub-002 epochs was not found locally.
